[0109] The embodiment of FIG. 7 was measured to have a flow resistance of about 0.059 (cmH 2 O) 0.5 /L min −1 . Its performance was tested in vitro using a cascade impactor, at a volumetric flow rate of 90 L min −1 , which corresponds to approximately a 2 kPa pressure drop across the inhaler. Several medicaments were tested, and results are shown below in Table 1.
